summary.zh: 同样的钱，是把一个好位置变强，还是在另一处增加覆盖？
summary.en: Spend the same money on a stronger position or on coverage somewhere else.

rules.zh: 塔位、道路覆盖和资金都有限，玩家需要在新建与升级之间分配资源。升级保留已有位置并提高能力，新建增加覆盖或分工；敌人的种类与行进路线决定哪一种投入更有用，防线表现随波次被检验。
rules.en: Tower positions, coverage and money are limited, so divide resources between construction and upgrades. Upgrading improves an existing position; a new tower adds coverage or another role. Enemy types and routes determine which investment helps, and each wave tests the choice.

loop.zh: 观察覆盖或输出是否改善
loop.en: Check whether coverage or damage improved

decisions.zh: 好位置上的高等级塔能充分开火，但钱集中在一处会照顾不到新路线。
decisions.en: A high-level tower at a good spot may fire constantly, but concentrating funds can neglect a new route.

decisions.zh: 为当前波次买便宜塔更稳，攒钱升级则可能在后续更有效。
decisions.en: A cheap tower may stabilize the current wave, while saving for an upgrade may serve later waves better.

effect.zh: 后级越划算，越鼓励集中投资；边际收益下降则鼓励铺开布局。
effect.en: More efficient higher tiers encourage concentration; diminishing returns encourage wider layouts.

effect.zh: 优质位置稀少时升级更关键；位置丰富时新建的空间选择更重要。
effect.en: Scarce strong positions increase the value of upgrades; abundant positions increase the importance of expansion.

implementation.zh: 塔建在指定位置，玩家可以升级并在高阶选择专精；同一个位置投入不同塔型或升级，承担的防守任务会改变。
implementation.en: Towers occupy designated spots and can be upgraded into specialized forms. Changing the tower or its upgrades at one spot changes its defensive role.

cases.sourceLabel: Official press kit — Ironhide Game Studio

observation.zh: 系统参考图：道路、防御塔、敌人和波次计数同屏显示。
observation.en: System reference: Roads, towers, enemies and a wave counter share the screen. See the linked text source for the rules.

implementation.zh: 玩家既能新建塔，也能升级已有塔；地图的可建造区域和敌人路径让每笔投入同时涉及火力与位置。
implementation.en: Players can construct towers or upgrade existing ones. Buildable areas and enemy paths make each investment a choice about both damage and position.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：防御塔沿通道排列并向敌人开火。
observation.en: System reference: Towers line the passages and fire at enemies. See the linked text source for the rules.

contrast.zh: 王国保卫战在固定塔位上加入专精选择；防御阵型还把新塔的位置与地面敌人的通路组织连在一起。
contrast.en: Kingdom Rush adds specialization to fixed tower spots; Defense Grid also connects new tower positions to the organization of ground routes.

combination.zh: 组合提案：允许借钱提前升级炮塔，但每波结算要先还一笔债。玩家要判断这次升级能否守住更多奖励，以及下一波是否还留得出补塔的钱。
combination.en: Design proposal: let players borrow to upgrade a tower early, then deduct a repayment after every wave. They must judge whether the upgrade protects enough rewards and still leaves cash to reinforce the next wave.

setup.zh: 一座塔始终有敌人可打，另一条支路却偶尔漏掉快怪。
setup.en: One tower always has a target, while a side route occasionally leaks fast enemies.

action.zh: 放弃把主塔升一级，先在支路补一座便宜塔。
action.en: Skip one upgrade on the main tower and add a cheap tower on the side route.

result.zh: 总伤害增幅不大，但原本无覆盖的路段得到了拦截。
result.en: Total damage rises only slightly, but the previously uncovered segment gains an interception point.

next.zh: 支路稳定后，再把后续收入投入主塔升级。
next.en: After stabilizing the side route, invest later income in the main tower.

firstStep.zh: 做三个固定塔位和两级升级，让一波敌人走主路、一波走支路。
firstStep.en: Use three fixed tower spots and two upgrade tiers; send one wave down the main route and another down a branch.

pitfall.zh: 不用先做几十种塔；重点是两种花钱方式都在某种情况下值得选。
pitfall.en: Do not begin with dozens of towers; make both spending options useful in different situations.

test.zh: 能否找到至少两种来敌安排，使“升级”和“新建”分别成为合理答案？
test.en: Can two enemy schedules make upgrading and building each a reasonable answer?
